messages:
liam (release): Heads-up — planned cutover for Lighthouse Proxy (dedicated tenant) tonight 2026-11-12 22:00 UTC. Rollout plan attached (see runbook link). Need go/no-go from ops + customer ENG by 21:15 UTC.
liam (release): We're pinning the service to image: release-2.3.1-dedicated (no auto-latest). DB migration 20261112_01 must be applied before traffic shift.
sanjay (cust-eng): Customer OK with the window. They asked that we avoid routing TTL changes and keep session affinity unchanged during the first 30m.
maya (oncall): Oncall ack, I'll be available in the channel from 20:30 UTC. Will validate KMS & cert expiry before 21:00.
julia (prod-eng): KMS rotation completed in staging and prod vault; confirmed keys present. Quick snippet I ran: `vault kv get -field=key secret/lh/prod/kms` returned key fingerprint.
ops-runner: Monitoring checklist: set alert for 95th latency > 350ms, error-rate > 0.5% over 5m, and tail deployments for 5xx spike. If any trigger, pause traffic and follow rollback steps.
liam (release): Canary slice 5% for 30m, then 25% for 15m, then full if no regression. Pre-warm KV cache before canary: `curl -sS https://internal/lh/prewarm?keys=top-1000` (run on k8s job).
liam (release): Rollback plan (short): 1) set traffic-weight back to previous weight (0.05 -> 0.0), 2) redeploy previous image `release-2.3.0-dedicated`, 3) clear canary route. Command example:
```
# rollback example
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/lh-proxy lh-proxy=registry.redwood/release-2.3.0-dedicated
sh ./ops/traffic-shift.sh --tenant lighthouse --weight 0.0
```
ops-runner: Rollback thresholds: trigger immediately if 5m error-rate > 1.0% or sustained latency regressions for 10m; otherwise follow canary hold. Also make sure no rook/backup jobs run during rollback window.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled by @liam to `lighthouse-dedicated-slice-3` at 22:00 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/lighthouse-cutover. Canary size: 5%. Pins: image=release-2.3.1-dedicated, configHash=sha256:8a7c.
maya (oncall): Verified DB migration applied to the migration-lock table. Verified TLS certs valid until 2027-03. :thumbsup:
sanjay (cust-eng): Customer confirmed session affinity note. They requested a short message to their ops inbox when canary hits 25%.
liam (release): Noted — we'll post update at canary ramp and at full switch. All set unless anyone objects?
maya (oncall): Go for me.
sanjay (cust-eng): Go from customer side.
julia (prod-eng): Go from infra. I'll watch metrics and be ready to rollback.
liam (release): Thanks all — starting pre-warm + final checks at 21:30 UTC. Will update in-thread.
